| `test_tiu_detail.php` | Testing only | Move to `scripts/archive/` |
| `test_tkp_generator.php` | Testing only | Move to `scripts/archive/` |

**Command:**
```powershell
$testScripts = @(
    "test_api_get_soal.php",
    "test_generators.php",
    "test_integrity.php",
    "test_tiu_detail.php",
    "test_tkp_generator.php"
)

foreach ($script in $testScripts) {
    $source = "c:\xampp\htdocs\permen\scripts\$script"
    $dest = "c:\xampp\htdocs\permen\scripts\archive\$script"
    if (Test-Path $source) {
        Move-Item -Path $source -Destination $dest -Force
        Write-Host "Archived: $script"
    }
}
```
